input.command:
git add -A && git status --short | wc -l && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Add book reservation queue

Members can reserve a book that is on loan. Reservations for a book form
a FIFO queue; when the book is returned, only the head of the queue can
loan it, and that loan consumes the reservation.

- POST /books/{bookId}/reservations returns 201 with reservationId and
  position (1-based). Reserving an available book returns 409
  BOOK_AVAILABLE; a discarded book returns 409 BOOK_DISCARDED.
- GET /books/{bookId}/reservations lists the live queue in order.
- POST /loans for a book with a queue returns 409 RESERVED_FOR_OTHER
  unless the caller is the head of the queue. A successful loan by the
  head deletes that reservation.
- A member who already holds a reservation for a book gets 409
  ALREADY_RESERVED instead of a second place in the queue.
- Reserve, loan, and return lock the book row so the queue checks and
  status changes cannot interleave. Return now uses the locking book
  lookup it previously lacked.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

Members can reserve a book that is on loan. Reservations for a book form
a FIFO queue; when the book is returned, only the head of the queue can
loan it, and that loan consumes the reservation.

- POST /books/{bookId}/reservations returns 201 with reservationId and
  position (1-based). Reserving an available book returns 409
  BOOK_AVAILABLE; a discarded book returns 409 BOOK_DISCARDED.
- GET /books/{bookId}/reservations lists the live queue in order.
- POST /loans for a book with a queue returns 409 RESERVED_FOR_OTHER
  unless the caller is the head of the queue. A successful loan by the
  head deletes that reservation.
- A member who already holds a reservation for a book gets 409
  ALREADY_RESERVED instead of a second place in the queue.
- Reserve, loan, and return lock the book row so the queue checks and
  status changes cannot interleave. Return now uses the locking book
  lookup it previously lacked.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log --oneline -1 && git status --short | wc -l

도서 예약 기능을 구현하고 커밋했습니다(`a092556 Add book reservation queue`). `./gradlew build` 는 통과했고, 기존 테스트 46개(기존 38개 + 신규 8개)가 모두 성공했습니다. 기존 테스트는 건드리지 않았습니다.

**구현한 것**
- `POST /books/{bookId}/reservations` → `201 {"reservationId", "position"}`. 대출 가능한 책은 `409 BOOK_AVAILABLE`.
- `GET /books/{bookId}/reservations` → 살아 있는 예약만 순서대로. 소진된 예약은 제외.
- `POST /loans`: 예약이 있는 책은 맨 앞 예약자만 빌릴 수 있고, 아니면 `409 RESERVED_FOR_OTHER`. 맨 앞 예약자가 빌리면 그 예약이 삭제되어 다음 사람이 맨 앞이 됩니다.
- 예약이 없는 책은 기존과 동일하게 동작합니다.

**제가 정한 부분 (요청에 없던 것)**
- 폐기된 책에 예약하면 `409 BOOK_DISCARDED` 를 씁니다.
- 같은 회원이 같은 책에 두 번 예약하면 `409 ALREADY_RESERVED` 를 씁니다. 줄에 같은 사람이 두 번 서는 상태를 막기 위한 것이니, 원치 않으면 말씀해 주세요.
- 존재하지 않는 책이나 회원은 `404` 입니다.
- `ReturnLoanService` 가 책 행을 잠그도록 바꿨습니다(`loadBook` → `loadBookForUpdate`). 반납과 예약이 동시에 일어날 때 상태 검사가 엉키지 않게 하기 위해서입니다.

**확인하지 못한 것**
- 동시 요청 시나리오는 테스트하지 않았습니다. 잠금 순서로만 설계를 검토했습니다.
